Bernoulli(p) raw moments are Bernstein mixtures over uniform fixed-size samples; linear independence of the Bernstein basis makes complete Bernoulli mean and second-moment profiles *equivalent* to full fixed-count profiles. Hence the submitted variance-resolves-nine classification is an immediate special case of stronger exact coverage. Faller–Pardi–Steel 2008 full primary Lemma 2.1 already gives the nested-clade covariance formula, from which the displayed 2p(1-p)^7 gap is a routine explicit two-tree evaluation. Neither reformulation nor specific gap creates an unaddressed original substantive claim.
